description: This file contains code to initialize internationalization settings, fetch total record counts from Algolia, generate localized search placeholder text, and write it to a JSON file for use in a search UI component.

methods.name: roundDownToNearestHundred
methods.description: Rounds a number down to the nearest hundred.

methods.name: convertToLocalizedString
methods.description: Converts a number to a localized string based on ISO code.

methods.name: generateSearchPlaceholder
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a localized search placeholder text based on total records from Algolia or a mock value, and writes it to a JSON file.
